timing: Previous complete calendar month; assumed available after first session of next month; analytical entry at next month's second session close and exit at following month's second session close. Historical publication and revisions unverified.
price_basis: raw close plus announced gross cash reinvested at ex-date close; fractional theoretical index, no actual fills
primary_statistic: Spearman score versus next interval total return

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap; resample paired score/return rows then rerank

continue_requirements: full-sample Spearman lower 5 percent bootstrap bound > 0
positive gross timing difference versus the same mean exposure in both full and later periods
positive selected gross mean in the later period
both signal states present in each subperiod
controls: Report fixed regression coefficient with prior available 10-session ETF total return and 10-session daily realized volatility; descriptive confounder diagnostic only, never threshold selection.
stopping_rule: One actual outcome read/execution. If necessary gross criteria fail, close exact hypothesis as not qualified; no sign flip, threshold or window rescue. A pass only permits a separately registered 10000-CNY net-account review; it cannot promote to paper or verify positive EV.
review_authority: Project lead self-review under the user's continuing autonomous research mandate; not an independent reviewer. New derivatives-input hypothesis, old closed-family authorizations unchanged.
